item.title: Create a logo for Recase project
item.dc:creator: Recase
item.description: Recase is a small elixir project to convert string from any case to any case. It now supports camelCase, UpperCase, snake_case and kebab_case. We need a branding: just a simple logo to picture repo’s main functionality.
item.content:encoded:
Organization: Recase

Status: closed

Compensation: gratis

Role: Logo design

Recase is a small elixir project to convert string from any case to any case. It now supports camelCase, UpperCase, snake_case and kebab_case.

We need a branding: just a simple logo to picture repo’s main functionality.

How to Apply:

  • Nikita Sobolev - mail@sobolevn.me Or github: https://github.com/sobolevn
